Upstream reader build uses unpinned stb source; the package does not publish
its resolved stb revision. This binary is retained exactly as published.

Only the reader is used. Upstream's writer/Zint and full WASM are not served
or imported by Spendscape. The npm archive itself also contains those unused
entry points; no separate writer library has been installed.

The application integration and fictional demo catalog are Spendscape code;
the upstream reader binary is unmodified. These notices are not an endorsement.
